dsh-zen-remote
One DeepSeek Harness plugin, two roles. The host turns DSH into a phone-reachable PWA
(mobile UI, pairing gateway, lock-screen push) and shares chosen sessions to paired desktops. The c
lient runs inside another DSH desktop app and puts the host's shared sessions right into its own sid
ebar (up to 8 hosts connected simultaneously) — full history, live progress, messages, approvals, te
rminal, everything executes on the host.

## 1. Install
### Install from the UI (Recommended, Desktop App & Web UI)
Open the **Plugins** page in the DSH sidebar → click **Add plugin** → type `dsh-zen-remote` → click
**Enable now** when the install finishes, then restart the DSH desktop app (or `dsh web`).
### Install from the CLI (Headless `dsh web` server)

> `dsh plugin` requires `--profile` to name the target profile. The desktop app's `desktop` profile
is managed exclusively by the app (`--profile desktop` is refused on the CLI), so use the UI install
above on the desktop app.
## 5. Features
- **Mobile PWA UI (Host)**: two-level page stack (session list home + session page with swipe-back a
nd Android back-gesture support, first-frame boot skeleton, immutable asset caching), auto-discovere
d plugin entry chips, compact mobile composer with bottom sheets and phone attachment uploads, and a
session info card (6-tile stats with `tok/s` output speed, log export, rename, fork, archive, one-t

ap full-conversation PNG share image, and remote access switch).
- **Unified Setup Wizard & Headless
CLI (`dsh-zen-remote`)**: top-of-page 2×2 live overview card, 3-step modal wizard, and a full-featu
red terminal CLI (`setup` / `status` / `host` / `client`) covering all four host ingress modes (Mana
ged Caddy, Existing Reverse Proxy, Cloudflare Tunnel, LAN / Tailscale Direct with private-IP wall) a

nd client pairing.
- **Cross-Desktop Remote Sessions & Multi-Server Pool (Client)**: connect up to *
*8 main servers** simultaneously in pairing order; supports full history & live streaming, approval/
question sync, per-server isolated model catalog, file tree & Git diffs, duplex server-side terminal
(`terminal/attach`), inline Markdown image & media forwarding, windowed artifact downloads, server-
side LibreOffice PDF preview, up to 500 MiB file uploads (drag-and-drop, paperclip picker, and paste

), and one-click redacted diagnostics export.
- **Plugin Bridge**: cooperative plugins and built-in
adapters (such as `dsh-better-sidebar` `0.25.0`–`0.30.1`) route their panel HTTP and WebSocket reque
sts in remote sessions to the host machine (with explicit owner consent for whole-machine data). See
Plugin Bridge Guide.
In depth: Interface Design · Public Access & Relay Protocol
## 7. Security Model, Version Tolerance & Known Notes
- **Trusted client & strict session isolation**: a paired desktop client runs terminals and file pre
views as the host's OS user, while unshared sessions are strictly filtered and refused at the relay
layer. Even when binding `0.0.0.0` for LAN/Tailscale, the gateway's private-IP wall rejects any unpr
oxied public internet IP (`403 public-direct-forbidden`), and all admin/wizard mutations are restric

ted to the host machine itself.
- **Version tolerance**: both ends must run the same `dsh-zen-remote
` version; DSH host versions may differ (interface fingerprints are compared at handshake and degrad
e only mismatched panels).
Expand security & state-file details, known limitations, iOS PWA notes & adapted third-party plugins

**Data & state files**
- The plugin reports nothing to any third party. Pairing state lives in `~/.d
sh/lan-gate-state.json`; the unified state file `~/.dsh/zen-remote-state.json` (`0600`) carries the
local `serverId`, the shared-session table `sessions`, and the client's paired servers list `servers
` (up to 8 servers, tokens included); Cloudflare tokens live in `0600` files under `~/.dsh/zen-remot
ervers, tokens included); Cloudflare tokens live in `0600` files under `~/.dsh/zen-remote-ingress/`.

**Known limitations**
- With multiple DSH windows open simultaneously on a client, active-session de

tection may occasionally dismiss a closed session early.
- Switching between different servers or re

creating a workspace with the same ID requires reloading the client page once.
- "Export session" an

d server-local OS dialogs ("Reveal in Finder" / "Open in app") are hidden in remote sessions.
- DSH'
s own Settings RPCs are loopback-only by upstream design, so plugin settings must be edited on the m
achine running DSH rather than through a remote browser.

**iOS standalone PWA notes**
- **iOS 26.x viewport shrinkage**: home-screen PWAs may lose a status-b
ar height at the bottom (an iOS WebKit bug); three mitigation layers are built in, and restarting th

e PWA restores full height.
- **iOS 26+ top progressive blur**: opening from the home screen may sho
w a system `WKScrollPocket` blur across the top ~95px; entering any session and navigating back to t
llPocket` blur across the top ~95px; entering any session and navigating back to the list clears it.
